description: `x.lo = 0` keeps `lo <= hi` (r.lo becomes 0); `x.lo = 7` breaks it and traps before the local is rebound, so `@r = x` never runs (r.lo stays 0).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 "When it is checked" lists "a local value of the type"; rule 10: the run-time check raises E-WRITE-INVARIANT-RT before the write.
